description: We are a creative and passionate team specializing in programming, Unity game development, graphic design, 3D modeling, and sound design. We combine our skills to create engaging and innovative gaming experiences.
summary:
Project Concept:
​An interactive educational simulation game titled "Mars Survival" mirroring NASA astronauts' challenges on Mars.
​The spacecraft malfunctions upon landing, prompting the player to survive by collecting "Archive Notes" featuring real stories and solutions from past NASA missions.
​Historical NASA Notes & Missions Used:
​Note 1: Overcoming low solar power and dust accumulation on solar panels by utilizing an alternative backup reactor.
​Note 2 (Phoenix 2008 Mission): Digging into Martian soil to extract subsurface water ice and essential elements.
​Note 3 (MOXIE 2021 Mission): Extracting and generating pure breathable oxygen directly from the carbon dioxide atmosphere.
​Submission Details:
​Project details and descriptions have been compiled and entered in English.
​Official NASA source links have been properly integrated for eligibility.
​Verified that the Demo link (screen recording under 30 seconds with no under-18 individuals appearing) and Final Project link are fully accessible.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

This is an interactive educational Mars survival simulation game based on real NASA data. After the player's spacecraft malfunctions on Mars, they explore and collect archive notes containing real astronaut stories and solutions (such as clearing solar panel dust, extracting ice, and operating the MOXIE oxygen unit).

​What benefits does it have and its intended impact?

The project simplifies the complex engineering challenges of space missions for younger generations in a fun, engaging way, raising scientific awareness of NASA's space exploration efforts and self-sufficiency in harsh environments.

​What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

The prototype was developed using C#,Unity and custom UI/UX design tools to simulate the Martian environment, leveraging official NASA data and mission resources.

​How is your project creative?

Its creativity lies in integrating "historical NASA mission stories" directly into the survival gameplay mechanics. Players do not just play; they learn and apply actual solutions used by NASA engineers in reality.
